name: Context menu
oneLiner: files sit on a desktop in slow 3D, the pointer glides onto a video file and right-clicks: it selects, a glass menu opens from the pointer, the hover walks down Open, Rename, Duplicate, Share to the accent action item whose glyph spins, the click closes the menu, a progress ring runs on the file and a toast lands with a green check and the result
say: when the speaker says it is built right into the computer or one right-click away ('just right-click the file and hit summarise', 'it shows up in the menu'): the menu opens on 'right-click', the pick lands on the action's name, the toast on the result
